problem: Player changes and pocketed balls resize the HUD and table; ball-in-hand after a non-scratch foul is unexplained; cue preview ignores shot power.
reuseDecision: Extend the existing CSS/player view with a fixed-height horizontally scrollable pocket shelf alongside the name, single-line status, and fixed shot-action footprint. Preserve the domain-owned 8-ball standard-foul rule; explicitly show its reason and test placement permissions. Extend existing prediction using actual strike speed, rolling deceleration and first-collision geometry rather than adding a physics engine. Native overflow and existing browser harness suffice; no package or subsystem is added.
nonGoals: Changing 8-ball into scratch-only house rules or expanding club pyramid scope
Changing actual physics, remote authority or any byte/UI limit
Overwriting concurrent island work or merging main
acceptance: HUD, stage and primary control bounds stay constant through real turns, pocket events, fouls, placement and reset on all six required viewports
Pocket history never wraps or enlarges the HUD; both players can scroll all their potted balls, and full status remains available
Legal miss and legal pot do not grant placement; each implemented standard foul does; placement consumes the permission once; pyramid retains its own rules
The foul reason and bitok-s-ruki explanation remain visible during placement instead of only a generic instruction
Cue preview grows with weak/medium power, stops at first reachable collision, omits unreachable object guides, and uses the selected pyramid striker
Strict types, domain and source checks, existing budgets and all four production/Pages browser suites pass for the exact release
